# Commander Voss

Commander Voss is the iron-fisted leader of the [[factions/crimson_order]] and one of the realm's most feared antagonists. From his fortress stronghold at the [[locations/iron_citadel]], Voss has orchestrated campaigns that have reshaped the balance of power across the land.

## Background

Though little is known about his early life, Voss rose to prominence during [[events/the_shattering]], where he demonstrated military genius and ruthless pragmatism. He has since grown the Crimson Order into a regional superpower.

## Legacy

Voss's strategies continue to influence regional politics, and his reputation precedes him wherever the Order's banners fly.
